mechanics: CPU postprocessing completed successfully; four Z7 chain sets read; no observed CF4 data read.

findings.bias_density_degeneracy: Posterior bias-unit correlations with white-field RMS are within about 0.06 in counts-only and 0.04 in velocity-only cases; correlations with log-density are within about 0.10 and 0.04. The Z4 joint-MAP bias runaway is not a simple posterior linear correlation in these chains.
findings.density_amplitude: Counts-only posterior physical-density SD is about 0.756-0.760 of the PM truth SD; velocity-only is about 0.800-0.805. Both are smooth relative to truth, with counts still providing much stronger structure correlation.
findings.interpretation: The remaining missing structure is more consistent with prior/likelihood model smoothing or missing nonlinear tracer physics than with a single unconstrained bias-amplitude direction. This does not prove the model is correct.
findings.scope: Development-only chain audit, not an actual CF4 information frontier or calibration certificate.
